mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_sku(product_id, sku_code, specs, price, stock, image) VALUES(#{productId}, #{skuCode}, #{specs}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{image})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock + #{delta} >= 0
UPDATE product_sku SET sales = GREATEST(0, sales - #{quantity}) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product_sku SET sales = sales + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
